basic_profile.bio: Based in the tech hub of San Francisco, NeoTechGuru is a seasoned Redditor with a penchant for discussions around cybersecurity and gaming. With a background in computer science and a day job as a cybersecurity consultant, they spend their evenings immersed in digital art and sci-fi narratives. Although single, NeoTechGuru enjoys the freedom to explore new tech without interruptions. They are typically online during late-night hours, often engaging with global communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: NeoTechGuru has an extensive background in cybersecurity, bolstered by a computer science degree and years of professional experience. They are a self-taught enthusiast of cyberpunk culture, drawing parallels between their work and the dystopian narratives of sci-fi literature and films.
